about_the_game:
Play Friends for up to 8 player party games where your phone is the controller. Pick a mini-game, grab your phone, and jump straight into the action. No complicated setups, no extra controllers, just instant fun whether you're together on the couch or connecting from different cities.

Turn any screen to a party. Your TV, computer monitor, tablet, whatever works. One person hosts, everyone else joins with their phone in seconds. It's that simple.

The Games That Get Everyone Playing

Knockout

Push everyone off the platform and be the last one standing. Dodge attacks, grab power-ups, and send your friends flying into the void. Simple rules, total chaos, and someone always wants one more round.

Ship Shapes

Your phone turns into a drawing pad. Complete the patterns before time runs out or watch your ship sink. Sounds easy until the pressure kicks in and suddenly nobody remembers how to draw a circle.

AniMatch

Find and match the right character faster than everyone else. Pattern matching at crazy speeds where one wrong tap drops you to last place. Your reflexes better be ready.

Punchline

Write the funniest answer, vote for your favorites, laugh at how bad everyone's jokes are. Somehow the worst ones always win. That's what makes it perfect.

Zero Setup Hassle

Here's how easy it is:

  • You start the game on your PC

  • A room code shows up on screen

  • Friends scan the QR code with their phones

  • Everyone's in and playing

No app downloads for your friends. No accounts. No waiting. Just scan and play through their phone browser.

Play Anywhere

Together in person? Perfect for parties, game nights, family gatherings.

In different places? Share your screen on Discord, Zoom, or Steam. Distance doesn't matter.

Streaming? Your viewers can jump in with the room code. Turn your chat into players.

What Makes It Click

  • Phones as controllers: Draw, tilt, tap, type. Each game uses your phone differently 

  • Instant access: Friends join through any phone browser 

  • Always fresh: New mini-games dropping regularly 

  • No barriers: Works with any smartphone

  • Flexible groups: 2-8 players per game

Join the Community

Jump into our Discord server! Find players for late night games, suggest new mini-games, share your best moments, and see what's coming next. We're building this game with our community, and your ideas matter.

Try the Demo Right Now

Play the demo today! Test out the games, see how easy it is to get friends playing, and experience the chaos yourself. The demo's free and ready to go.

Languages

Currently supporting 12+ languages: English, Portuguese, Spanish, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Japanese, Russian, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, and Filipino. More languages coming soon.

One Purchase = Endless Parties

You buy it once. Your friends play free forever. No subscriptions, no extra purchases, no hidden costs. Just unlimited game nights whenever you want them.

Created by Plot Interactive, backed by Google Indie Games Fund 2024

Ready to be the person who brings the fun? Add to your wishlist and get notified when new updates drop!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 and Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750-Ti / AMD RX 550, 2GB VRam
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 and Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580, 4GB VRam / Intel Arc A380
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: A party game where everyone's phone is the controller. Battle on platforms, draw fast, match symbols, or write funny answers, across 4 mini-games, up to 8 players, local or online.
supported_languages:
English*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Spanish - Latin America*, Spanish - Spain*, Indonesian*, Japanese*, Russian*, Simplified Chinese*, Thai*, Traditional Chinese*, Ukrainian*, Vietnamese*, Filipino*
*languages with full audio support
